sources.title: Federal Workforce Data
sources.coverage: Official federal civilian workforce aggregates, downloadable datasets, monthly updates, workforce composition and change measures.
sources.limits: Aggregate workforce data do not expose the complete decision-level roster, agency DEIA inventory submissions, exceptions, overrides, or no-action rows.

sources.title: OPM public datasets
sources.coverage: Downloadable employment, accession, separation, and related federal workforce files.
sources.limits: Published statistical files do not provide person-level protected personnel decisions or complete programme and office disposition files.

sources.title: Federal Workforce Data getting started
sources.coverage: Documents available FWD dimensions, downloadable data, update cadence, and public-use boundaries.
sources.limits: Documentation describes the data surface rather than completing any contested affected-person or decision denominator.

sources.title: Federal Register API documentation
sources.publisher: Office of the Federal Register and Government Publishing Office
sources.coverage: Public API endpoints for presidential documents, rules, notices, agencies, dates, and document metadata.
sources.limits: Federal Register publication does not contain every internal delegation, dissent, recusal, implementation file, or no-action decision.

sources.title: USAspending API
sources.coverage: Comprehensive standardized federal award data covering contracts, grants, recipients, agencies, amounts, and geography.
sources.limits: The award universe does not by itself identify which rows were subject to a disputed condition, certification, investigation, termination, correction, or no-action decision.

sources.title: USAspending API documentation
sources.coverage: Endpoint, filter, and technical documentation for programmatic award-universe acquisition.
sources.limits: API documentation establishes addressability, not the completeness of downstream enforcement or recovery joins.

sources.title: SAM.gov Contract Award Data
sources.coverage: Federal contract actions required to be reported, with agency, entity, identifier, competition, date, status, and other fields.
sources.limits: Public contract data do not preserve every certification, records request, referral, declination, investigation, appeal, or no-action row.

sources.title: Contract Awards in SAM.gov
sources.coverage: Documents the February 24, 2026 transition of public FPDS contract-award functionality into SAM.gov.
sources.limits: System migration documentation does not establish a condition-specific action denominator.

sources.title: SAM.gov Federal Assistance
sources.coverage: Searchable assistance listings, federal assistance programmes, and subaward reports.
sources.limits: Programme and subaward listings do not enumerate every certification, withholding, termination, continuation, correction, or no-action disposition.

sources.title: Grants.gov opportunity search
sources.publisher: U.S. Department of Health and Human Services
sources.coverage: Public federal funding-opportunity records with agency, status, dates, expected awards, and award ranges.
sources.limits: Opportunity records do not supply the complete post-award recipient, condition, action, appeal, and recovery ledger.

sources.title: Justice Department Establishes Civil Rights Fraud Initiative
sources.coverage: Defines the Civil Rights Fraud Initiative and the use of the False Claims Act against federal funding recipients.
sources.limits: The initiative announcement is not a complete investigation, declination, referral, settlement, or no-action register.

sources.title: IBM Civil Rights Fraud Initiative resolution
sources.coverage: Named April 10, 2026 False Claims Act resolution under the Civil Rights Fraud Initiative, including represented payment and remediation terms.
sources.limits: One announced resolution does not establish enforcement prevalence, a complete contractor register, realized recovery beyond the instrument, or system-wide remedy adequacy.

sources.title: Deputy Attorney General select publications
sources.coverage: Official index for current Deputy Attorney General policy memoranda, including the Civil Rights Fraud Initiative.
sources.limits: A publication index does not expose internal referrals, staffing, budgets, declined matters, exceptions, or decision custody.

sources.title: GAO Bid Protests
sources.coverage: Official bid-protest process, published decisions, docket search, filing, and review routes.
sources.limits: GAO does not publish every pleading, routine dismissal decision, implementation record, cost, access, or durable corrective-action outcome.

sources.title: GAO Bid Protest FAQs
sources.coverage: Documents searchable docket fields, publication practices, redaction, and limits on public decisions and pleadings.
sources.limits: The FAQ confirms that routine dismissals and many underlying documents are not automatically public, so the public docket is not the complete correction denominator.

sources.title: PACER Case Locator
sources.publisher: Administrative Office of the U.S. Courts
sources.coverage: Nationwide index for federal district, bankruptcy, and appellate case records, updated daily.
sources.limits: PACER requires registration, charges for many records, omits sealed material, and does not itself provide complete practical access, cost, remedy, compliance, or durability measures.

sources.title: MSPB Case Reports
sources.coverage: Official index for MSPB precedential, nonprecedential, and case-report materials.
sources.limits: Published decisions do not expose the complete grievance, settlement, abandoned, no-action, implementation, access, cost, and durability universe.

sources.title: Federal Audit Clearinghouse data
sources.coverage: Public single-audit packages and structured award and finding data for non-federal entities meeting the statutory expenditure threshold.
sources.limits: Single-audit coverage is thresholded, some tribal material may be suppressed, and the data do not provide every award condition, termination, repayment, clawback, or no-recovery row.

sources.title: Federal Audit Clearinghouse API resources
sources.coverage: API guides, dictionaries, versioning, pagination, and public access to submitted single-audit data.
sources.limits: API availability does not make FAC a complete recovery or continuity ledger and requires careful handling of threshold and suppression boundaries.
